centre.name: Port Alberni Friendship Centre
centre.address: 3555 4th Ave, Port Alberni, BC V9Y 4H3, Canada

about_blocks.text: Program Philosophy and Goals The Alcohol and Drug department at the Friendship Center offers counselling to either family, group or individuals. With appointments, referrals, or on a drop-in basis. We do assessments for treatment and refer to other agencies. We assist in prevention and support for a healthy lifestyle. We continue to support and counsel through recovery and follow-up. Our primary goal is to provide service for Urban First Nations People but are available for anyone in the community. We believe in the Holistic approach to a healthy lifestyle and that culture is healing.

sponsor.text: Are you or a loved one struggling with alcohol or drug addiction? Finding the right addiction treatment centre can make all the difference in achieving long-term recovery. That's why we've done the research for you and compiled a list of the best alcohol and drug addiction centres in Canada. Our list includes top-rated addiction treatment centres that provide evidence-based therapies, personalized treatment plans, and aftercare support services to help clients overcome addiction and maintain a healthy, fulfilling life in recovery. Whether you're looking for residential or outpatient treatment, we've got you covered. For immediate treatment help call: 1-855-885-4747
